case: Strict zero-date SQL mode behavior on MySQL 8 and MariaDB 11
contract: Dedicated sessions on MySQL 8 and MariaDB 11 confirm STRICT_TRANS_TABLES, NO_ZERO_DATE and NO_ZERO_IN_DATE are active.
Both servers refuse zero and incomplete DATE values with SQLSTATE 22007.
Both refusals leave no rows; a valid DATE persists as the exact native date and text.
The existing permissive-mode zero/partial-date read contract remains covered in the MySQL/MariaDB value-contract run.

mysql_focused.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-mysql --test integration value_contracts::strict_zero_date_modes_refuse_invalid_dates_without_writing -- --include-ignored --exact --test-threads=1

mariadb_focused.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-mysql --test integration value_contracts::mariadb_strict_zero_date_modes_refuse_invalid_dates_without_writing -- --include-ignored --exact --test-threads=1

mysql_mariadb_value_contract_group.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-mysql --test integration value_contracts:: -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-mysql --all-targets -- -D warnings
